selection_rationale: One known skill and implementation module (skills/feat-engine/, feat_engine.py) was named for dependency and integrity audit.

contract.use_case: Statically extract normalized feature vectors, profile multi-factor execution risks, and evaluate harness compatibility for agent skills without third-party dependencies
contract.recurrence: Per-skill audit on candidate ingestion, dependency checking, and CI/SDLC gating
contract.inputs_outputs: Input: Skill directory path containing SKILL.md and optional scripts. Output: Canonical JSON report / CLI summary with vector_hash, risk verdict, and compatibility status.
hard_constraints: Purely static analysis (no execution of untrusted scripts)
contract.evidence_bar: 100% stdlib import verification, AST inspection verification, static shell scanning verification, and unit test pass confirmation

security_boundaries.isolation_mechanism: Static AST traversal (ast.parse) and regex-based tokenization without executing or importing candidate files

verification_brief.published_description: Statically extract normalized feature vectors, profile multi-factor execution risks, and evaluate harness compatibility for agent skills without third-party dependencies. Use when analyzing untrusted or new skills, auditing capabilities, or gating skill adoption in workflows.
verification_brief.why_it_wins_here: Standard-library-only implementation with zero supply chain risk, deterministic cryptographic vector hashing, and sub-50ms execution speed.

facts: 0 external pip dependencies or package manifests introduced
All 12 imported modules are part of the Python 3.9+ standard library
80 unit tests passed via python3 -m unittest discover tests
Deterministic vector hash verified across repeated runs (sha256:f8e351b184d6cfb2dc8a6ef0f32d0dd9630ce1d6186b303d4250c43615fe0181)
inference: Zero supply chain attack surface from third-party wheels or transitive dependencies
Safe for automated CI/SDLC pipelines and local agent gating
unknowns: Obfuscated base64 shell payloads cannot be dynamically decompiled without emulation (mitigated via piped execution risk detection)

verification_brief.runner_up_gap: No equivalent stdlib-only agent skill feature extraction engine exists in the local environment or Tink library.
verification_brief.risks_and_adaptation: Requires Python 3.9+ runtime on the host system. No external network connectivity or elevated permissions required.
verification_brief.coverage: Full coverage over SKILL.md frontmatter, Python AST parsing, shell lexical scanning, and harness profiles (pi, claude, codex, generic).
verification_brief.next_gate: Proceed to Stage 04 verification run via `_system/scripts/verify.sh feat-engine`. Explicitly state that all other private access, installation, configuration, testing, and execution remain unauthorized and each requires separate explicit approval.
